title: Cinematic Nightmare
description: A surreal gothic scene features a giant monochrome woman's face with swirling white hair filled with stars, projecting a beam of light from her eyes onto a woman in a flowing red dress holding a film reel. The background contains a ruined white picture frame dripping with red liquid, a floating skull with a red spiral above, a small house with a striped awning, broken film reels, roses, and a white picket fence under a dark sky.
